subject: Subprocessor change control — notification cadence, SIG signoff, and evidence runbook
messages:
From: EdgeStream Notifications <notifications@edgestream.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@datagov.co
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Upcoming subcontractor: TelemetryNow (planned 6/1)

Hi Vivek,

Heads up — EdgeStream will be adding TelemetryNow as a downstream telemetry partner for a pilot starting 2026-06-01. TelemetryNow will only receive aggregated service metrics (no tenant IDs, no raw logs).

We’ve attached a short delta CSV that lists the functions TelemetryNow will perform and the countries their infra may transit through. Full SOC2 + encryption attestation already included in our vendor pack (see link below).

Request: we’d like to notify your team and get a list of evidence items you’ll need (sample logs, onshore fallback plan, DSAR handling, KMS boundaries). We can provide a 30-day notice window for the pilot.

Attachment: subprocessor_delta_20260518.csv
Links: https://drive.google.com/edge-vendor-pack

Thanks,
Chen Park
Vendor Ops, EdgeStream
notifications@edgestream.io
(Attachment: vendor-pack.zip stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Chen Park <notifications@edgestream.io>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming subcontractor: TelemetryNow (planned 6/1)

Thanks for the early notice, Chen — this is helpful. A couple of quick asks from our side so we can evaluate and route appropriately: 

- Can you confirm exactly which token/metric dimensions will be shared? Avoiding tenant-level identifiers is critical.
- Provide the TelemetryNow SOC2 report and any evidence of encryption in transit for aggregation endpoints.
- Confirm whether TelemetryNow will ever see any request/response payloads — our default block is no PII/ML prompt content.
- Please include the proposed fallback/onshore routing plan if TelemetryNow is unavailable.

Internal note: Naomi, Laura — can you pick this up and propose a notification cadence? I want a lightweight change-control path:
- Initial intake review (security/compliance) within 3 business days
- Evidence checklist and procurement signoff within 10 business days
- Final 30-day customer notification trigger

I’ll loop Legal if any DPA redlines required.

Vivek
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: none)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 13:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming subcontractor: TelemetryNow (planned 6/1)

Vivek / Laura —

I pulled the vendor delta and sketched a minimal evidence runbook. High-level items we need from EdgeStream / TelemetryNow: 

1) Service scope CSV (functions, data types) — confirms no prompt/request payloads
2) SOC2 Type II (last 12 months) — PDF
3) TLS cipher suite confirmation for aggregation endpoints 
4) Example aggregator output schema showing only aggregated metrics (sanitized sample)
5) Data residency / egress map (countries + cloud regions)
6) Onshore fallback plan (IP ranges + contact, automatic reroute timeline)
7) Incident contact for DSARs and sandbox access window for audit (48h access window requested)

Suggested internal cadence / SIG (change control):
- Intake: Security triage (Naomi) — 3 business days
- Evidence review: Security + Legal — 7 business days after intake
- Procurement: contract addendum and DPA appendix — 7 business days after evidence clear
- Final: Customer notification (30-day minimum)

I’ll convert this to a checklist PDF and drop into the Drive link. Also recommend we require a short onshore escrow/relay option for the pilot (temporary).

—Naomi
Senior Security PM, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: planned_evidence_runbook_draft.docx)

From: EdgeStream Notifications <notifications@edgestream.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@datagov.co
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming subcontractor: TelemetryNow (planned 6/1)

Hi Vivek / Naomi —

Thanks for the checklist. We can produce items 1–6 by Friday 2026-05-21. Quick clarifications:

- TelemetryNow will only receive pre-aggregated counters and latency percentiles (no identifiers).
- They will not have access to request/response bodies or prompts.
- SOC2 report is current; we’ll provide an encrypted PDF link.
- For onshore fallback we can provide an option to route telemetry to EdgeStream’s US-only collector for the pilot; that will be enabled by feature flag.

We’ve attached a small CSV with country egress and the contact info for TelemetryNow’s security lead.

Attachment: subprocessor_delta_20260518.csv

Happy to jump in a 20m call tomorrow if that helps.

Best,
Chen Park
Vendor Ops, EdgeStream

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming subcontractor: TelemetryNow (planned 6/1)

Team — quick summary and next steps for the change-control playbook: 

- Action items for EdgeStream (deliver by 2026-05-21): SOC2 PDF, sanitized sample output, TLS cipher confirmation, onshore fallback toggle details. Evidence link -> Drive folder above.
- Internal reviewers: Naomi (security), Kimberly (procurement/contract), Laura (privacy/legal touchpoint). Please target signoff by 2026-05-27 so we can confirm the 30-day notification and still meet the 6/1 pilot if the evidence is clean.
- If any item fails, we will request a temporary hold and require EdgeStream to enable the US-only collector before we allow pilot rollout.

I’ll generate a short DPA addendum template (boilerplate) and share for Kim to review.

Laura Bennett
Director, Legal Ops, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: evidence-checklist.pdf)
